newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telerj upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telerj upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Brazilian bank Banco Icatu said it raised its rating on Brazilian state telecommunications firm Telerj to outperformer/buy from market performer.
-- The bank also said it maintained its outperformer/buy ratings on sister firms Telesp, Telepar and Telemig.
-- All four firms are state-level operating subsidiaries of federal telecommunications giant Telebras.
-- Icatu cited a new proposed General Telecommunications Law, which was sent to Congress on Thursday, and a tariff adjustment expected to be announced in the coming weeks.
-- "Telerj will be the most benefitted from the rebalancing," it said in a report.
-- The bank also said all four firms, but particularly Telerj and Telesp, are expected to speed up installation of cellular lines in the fourth quarter and throughout 1997.
-- "Meanwhile, Telemig will continue to be the telco with the highest net margin," it said.
-- Icatu said Telepar has been ignored by stock market investors in recent months but remains the cheapest valuation per line in service among leading telecoms.
-- The bank also cited Tuesday's auction of a 35 percent stake in Rio Grande do Sul's state-run CRT telecom as a potentially positive influence on Brazilian telecoms stock prices.

-- Preferred shares of Telerj and Telepar were flat at 119 reais and 485 reais, respectively. Telesp preferred was off one real at 189 reais, and Telemig was off 3.00 reais at 118 reais at 1119 local/0819 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
